feature: Fix a11y gap surfaced in P3.2/P3.3 — scalar inputs now forward aria-invalid/aria-describedby

frontend.fixes_applied: DefaultInput, NumberInput, and TextAreaInput now forward aria-invalid + aria-describedby (declared on FieldProps and already passed by renderField) to the real <input>/<textarea>, so assistive tech links validation errors to the field. Only the two aria keys are read from rest props — no stray FieldProps leak to the DOM. Upgraded the renderField test from documenting the gap to asserting the full aria contract on the input.
frontend.framework_changes: Form validation errors are now programmatically associated with their inputs (WCAG 1.3.1 / 3.3.1).
frontend.issues: Re-examined the 'ListView refetch loop' flagged in id 5/6: it was a TEST artifact (incomplete uiStore mock made setPageTitle a new identity each render). Production ListView memoizes fetchData via useCallback with a complete, stable dep list and the effect depends on [fetchData, metadata] — no production infinite loop. No change needed.
